paragraphs.text: Firesong and Sunspeaker are Minotaur Clerics from Dominaria .

Firesong and Sunspeaker are two Hurloon Minotaur clerics. They are brother and sister, two siblings who fight together. They grew up high in the frigid mountains and worshiped heat due to this. Their names come from the sun that heated their harvest and the hearth fire that warmed their home. They are known for their skill in battle and their echoing ballads. Firesong and Sunspeaker fought in defense of Dominaria during the New Phyrexian Invasion .
